Anatomy of AI systems through interactive maps that can be used as a reference in the case of the measurement and or the LCA of an AI

he Turing Way is a reproducible, ethical and collaborative Data Science manual. Compliance with this criterion can be achieved in particular by providing an accessible HTML version or by making the document accessible in the format offered for download.
Typeface designed for maximum legibility for everyone: high contrast, restrained shapes, wide letterforms and unambiguous characters.

Toolkit published by the French government design team: methods, templates and checklists for designing public digital services, including accessibility and eco-design guidance.
Do's and don'ts posters on designing for accessibility, published by the UK government and translated into more than a dozen languages.

Digital skills assessment and certification platform for all. Digital is now everywhere. In our professional and private life. outils.nom: Apply the principles of green it
outils.description: It is common to hear that digital technology is “green”, that is to say that it has little or no ecological impact, or even that it reduces the ecological impacts of the rest of our economy. . In this MOOC, these two ideas will be questioned. Indeed, digital technology has on the contrary real and growing ecological impacts: greenhouse gas emissions, pollution, production of toxic waste, etc. In addition, its ability to reduce the ecological impacts of the rest of our economy is questionable (rebound effect, planned obsolescence, etc.).
French media outlet dedicated to dismantling the most common misconceptions about climate change, with sourced, referenced articles.
Account of Camille Étienne, a young French activist for social and climate justice, known for short-form explainers.

Lowtus is not versed in free, not necessarily out of discretion, but because the code remains very specific for the moment. We need to sit down the architecture to see how to eventually free some bricks from it.

Responsible management deals with the triple social, economic and environmental constraint of sustainable development. Bulk unsubscribe service for marketing emails and inbox clean-up. A mainstream entry point to data sobriety, often used alongside a Digital Cleanup Day.

Checklist for a software management plan. This checklist will help you write an SMP. It consists of sections that cover the key elements that an SMP should include. A software management plan (SMP) can help you define a set of structures and goals for understanding your research software, including what you will develop; who is the software for (even if it's just for you); how you will deliver your software to the users it is intended for; how it will help them; and how you will assess whether it has helped them and contributed to the research, as you intended. An SMP also helps you understand how you can support those who want or use your research software; how your software relates to other artifacts in your research ecosystem; and how you will ensure that your software remains available beyond the lifespan of your current project.

outils.nom: The carbon footprint of an email: myths and reality
outils.description: Sets aside the folklore and gives the actual carbon footprint of an email, with three ways to reduce it — and why emptying your inbox achieves almost nothing.
Development kit that lets an application shift its workloads to the times or regions where electricity is least carbon-intensive. Moves from measurement to action without changing the architecture.

CPU Energy Meter is a Linux tool that allows you to monitor the energy consumption of Intel processors with fine temporal granularities (a few tens of milliseconds). Power monitoring is available for the following power domains:
- by package domain (CPU socket)
- by core domain (all processor cores in a package)
- by uncore domain (uncore components, by example, integrated graphics on client processors)
- by memory node (local memory of a package, server processors only)
- by platform (all devices on the platform that are powered by an integrated power mechanism , for example, processor cores, SOC, memory, add-ons or peripherals)

Allows you to view the quantity of CO₂ emitted to produce your electricity, in real time.
The regions of the world are colored according to the carbon intensity (including all greenhouse gases) of the electricity consumed there.
Self-assessment questionnaire measuring how far a data centre meets energy efficiency best practice, and where the remaining gaps are.
Used to assess energy consumption according to programming languages.
Records energy data on a Raspberry Pi and allows you to plot graphs of your energy consumption.
Catalog of code smells dedicated to energy for Android apps
Estimates the electricity consumption of everyday electronic equipment, from a laptop to a fridge, and converts it into a running cost.

EnergyBox is a parameterized tool that allows precise studies of communication energy in the user, using real traffic traces as input. Currently, it focuses on the most popular wireless technologies (3G and WiFi) and emulates the communication energy footprint of application data at the user device level. EnergyBox performs iterative simulation based on the trace.

outils.nom: European code of conduct for data centers

Transfer of heavy files respecting the impacts that this type of tool can generate

Bulk image resizer: pick a target size and process a whole batch at once before publishing.

Aerial photographs of the Salar de Atacama and the SQM and Albemarle lithium evaporation ponds, showing the physical footprint of battery supply.
Open source energy metrology agent written in Rust. Measures a machine's power draw and attributes it process by process, on bare metal as well as in virtual machines. Exposes metrics to Prometheus.

Smartphones can contain around 80% of the stable elements in the periodic table. This graphic details the critical metals carried in a pocket.

Cabanon is an experimental visualization project exploring issues related to privacy and anonymization techniques by visually comparing the results obtained by anonymizing a dataset with different anonymization methods.
OPIDoR supports you through the development and implementation of data and software management plans
Starter kit for running an audit against the French RGAA accessibility framework.

Tool to measure the consumption of a given Docker order and see the evolution of its performance. Argos is able to measure the CPU, memory and network usage of Docker containers for a given order. By measuring the resource consumption of dockerized E2E tests, Argos makes it possible to compare the consumption of an application between its different versions.
Offers an environmental scan of your website.

Public database from the French environment agency gathering the emission factors and life-cycle data used for carbon accounting. The official French source for converting consumption into CO₂ equivalent.
Online carbon footprint calculator for a web page, returning a report on the heaviest resources and how to address them. Free analysis from a single URL.

Publication from Carbone 4, a consultancy supporting decarbonisation and climate adaptation, quantifying the real impact individual action can and cannot achieve.
LCA software allowing a rapid assessment of the carbon footprint of products. It allows to carry out an eco-design or to carry out a complete PAS2050 analysis (paid software)
Explores the hidden side of online activity in real time. Built by Equiwatt, Lausanne.

Cloud Carbon Footprint is an open source tool that offers a methodology and tools to measure, monitor and reduce your carbon emissions in the cloud. This approach integrates "Etsy's Cloud Jewels" Cloud kWh Estimate, to convert cloud usage into estimated energy consumption and carbon emissions.

Python script that estimates the carbon footprint of all Cloud Foundry (CF) applications in an organization. The script uses basic "cf cli" commands to count the number of running containers per space. This is then multiplied by an estimated average energy consumption
Methodology for carrying out the estimate in KWh in the Cloud
Calculator built by Decathlon to make professional digital impact easy to estimate, and to shed light on the effects of digital overconsumption at work.

JavaScript library converting a volume of transferred data into CO₂ emissions, with a choice of calculation model and the carbon intensity of the electricity grid taken into account. Lets an application display its own footprint.
Monitors the CO₂ emissions of IT services in real time, based on the actual consumption of virtual machines and servers.
Estimate and monitor carbon emissions from the calculation, quantify and analyze their impact.Allows you to calculate and reduce CO2 emissions from your IT
Cookieviz is a dataviz tool offered by the CNIL which allows you to monitor in real time the tracking of your navigation

Static analysis rules for reducing the environmental footprint of JavaScript and TypeScript programs, from the Green Code Initiative.

EcoIndex is a free service that provides the community with a simple way to assess the environmental performance achieved by a website / online service with regard to objective technical parameters: number of DOM elements, number of HTTP requests, weight of the 'URLs (KB transferred), etc.
Cypress plugin measuring a page's EcoIndex during automated tests, so the environmental score becomes an acceptance criterion like any functional test.

SonarQube plugin adding eco-design and accessibility to existing code quality analysis: EcoIndex, Lighthouse and green rules appear in the same dashboard as technical debt. Maintained by the Green Code Initiative.
Microsoft dashboard letting Azure customers measure the carbon emissions associated with their cloud usage, broken down by service and region.

Method to track energy consumption, carbon emissions, and calculate your system usage. Profiler built into Firefox exposing the CPU time, memory and energy a page consumes. A free diagnostic tool for finding what actually costs resources in a service.

Fruggr is an automated assessment platform for the environmental and social footprints of digital services. Thanks to its many KPIs, its objective is to improve the impact of companies' information systems by implementing a continuous improvement process. The license is commercial for the moment, even if in the future part of the code (the calculation engine) will be released in Open Source for the sake of transparency and sharing with the community.

Google Cloud customers get an environmental impact category in Active Assist Recommender, to measure and help reduce the IT impact of their workloads.

Catalogue of concrete actions to apply when writing greener code, each pattern tied to the impact it addresses.

Estimates the carbon footprint of a user scenario on a web application, from the command line so it can run in continuous integration. Built by Marmelab.

GreenIT-Analysis is a browser extension that allows you to quantify the environmental footprints of a complete user journey, even behind a firewall and / or application authentication. The tool also verifies the use of good practices aimed at reducing these impacts.
Online measurement and optimisation tool for websites: yearly carbon emissions for the site, plus the emissions of each individual page.
Software suite to allow you to measure, analyze, see to optimize your printing fleet in order to allow you more sobriety, savings, but also a better use of the printer fleet
Simulator for the environmental impact of a meeting, whether held in person or remotely. A simple, educational way to weigh meeting formats against each other.
Allows you to calculate your professional environmental footprint
Measures energy consumption through a small desktop application running on both PC and Mac.
Measures the power consumption of Java application source code at fine granularity, down to the individual method.

Joulemeter is an interesting application created by Microsoft that shows you the power consumption of each part of your computer. After analyzing your computer, it will calculate the power consumption of each element: motherboard, HD screen, etc. Through this analysis, the program can tell you the power consumption of each element in real time at any time. Joulemeter also records statistics of your consumption so that you can consult them in the future.
Eco-design audit for websites and web applications, based on the GR491 responsible design reference guide.
Simulator for the analytical modelling of energy consumption in cloud, fog and edge computing environments.
Excel media used by the working group to carry out the calculations presented in the report “Lean ICT - Pour une Sobriété Numérique” published on October 4, 2018 by The Shift Project.
Measures web page performance first and foremost, and returns improvement guidance that also reduces the environmental impact of a digital service. Built by Google.
Likwid is an easy-to-install and use command-line application tool suite for performance-oriented programmers. It works for Intel and AMD processors on Linux operating system.

Tool for transcribing eqCo2 into metrics that everyone can understand
Advanced Mac system monitor with temperature and fan plugins, reporting power draw from the menu bar.

While we generally know that eating meat and stealing is bad for our climate, it is difficult to take effective action. Is it better to stop eating meat or take the train instead of a plane? We believe that understanding the effects of your actions is essential to improve them. That's why we are building MyClimatePal to be the easiest way to better understand your CO2 footprint.
a node.js code to calculate the ecoindex of your web page
Calculates the environmental footprint of an entire information system, defined as the whole set of physical equipment, software and services that make it up. Developed for the French public sector.
Solidarity web development center for the employment of disabled workers

openLCA is open source LCA software that can be used for professional ecological, social and economic life cycle assessments. Among others, openLCA can be used for LCA, carbon and water footprints, eco-design, environmental product declarations, life cycle cost and social life cycle analysis.

Open source analyser detecting performance anti-patterns across several languages and scoring them with carbon awareness. Written in Rust under AGPL-3.0, it plugs into the development pipeline so software sobriety is treated as an ordinary quality defect.

Companion service to perf-sentinel: centralises findings from several instances and exposes them to IDE extensions through a single endpoint, retained for 180 days by default. Pre-1.0, with no stable release published to date.
Pingdom offers website availability and performance analysis: monitoring website availability, performance, and interactions.
This project includes two different tools: power_meter to record multiple power related sensors as a csv file and make_plot.py to generate power consumption graphs.
Simulates the power supply required for a workstation configuration, and therefore its energy consumption.

PowerAPI is a middleware toolkit for creating software-defined power meters. Software-defined power meters are configurable software libraries that can estimate software power consumption in real time. PowerAPI supports the acquisition of raw metrics from a wide variety of sensors (e.g. physical meters, processor interfaces, hardware counters, OS counters) and the provision of power consumption through different channels (including file system, network, web, graphics). As a middleware toolkit, PowerAPI offers the ability to assemble “à la carte” power meters to meet user needs.
Measures the power consumption of hardware components and software on GNU/Linux. Reports CPU and GPU energy for servers and PCs, and ARM CPU energy on supported boards.

Power / energy simulation in SystemC (not to be confused with VHDL). Powersim is a SystemC class library for calculating the power and energy consumption of hardware described at the system level. To this end, C ++ operators are monitored and different energy models can be used for each type of data.

PowerTOP is a Linux tool used to diagnose power consumption and power management issues. In addition to being a diagnostic tool, PowerTOP also has an interactive mode that you can use to experiment with various power management settings, in cases where the Linux distribution has not enabled these settings.
pTopW estimates the energy consumption of each process and component in each state. User can change these parameters according to their own platform to get more precise result.
A software toolkit for measuring the energy footprint of a host machine throughout the execution of a piece of Python code.

Utilities often use "smart meters" to optimize their residential meter reading infrastructure. Smart meters transmit consumption information in different ISM bands, which allows utilities to simply send readers through neighborhoods to collect product consumption information. One protocol in particular: Encoder Receiver Transmitter by Itron is fairly straightforward to decode and operates in the 900 MHz ISM band, well within the adjustable range of inexpensive rtl-sdr dongles. This project is a software-defined radio receiver for these messages. We use an inexpensive rtl-sdr dongle to enable users to non-invasively record and analyze their household product consumption.

After having explained the general context in a first sheet, a second sheet ("But why?") Highlights the need to integrate an environmental dimension in our digital service designs, and consequently in our software developments. The third sheet ("When?") Recalls the stages in the life cycle of a digital service to introduce the best practice sheets that correspond to the different stages: "Before", "During" and "After", keeping in mind the mind that development is often iterative, and the boundaries between the different stages are permeable.
